model: ROLEX Sea-Dweller 126600 (43 mm steel, black dial, black Cerachrom bezel with coin edge, date with Cyclops lens, Oyster bracelet with Glidelock end)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Sea-Dweller 43 template (126600 first; the Deepsea 136660 D-Blue follows): the Submariner Date 41 step / prep copied to variant-named files, re-measured on this photo (43 mm = coin-edge tip diameter, 23.0 px/mm, pivot (960, 1423)), plus a flute phase for the 60-flute coin edge. Case and lugs with the thick crown guards from the photo silhouette, ceramic insert + polished rim + fluted coin-edge ring, domed crystal, traced hand outlines, fluted crown, Cyclops date lens at 3 and the three-column Oyster bracelet at the photo's joints; dial, indices, print, date window and numeral, bezel numerals / scale / lume pearl and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. The helium escape valve (9 o'clock flank) is not visible in this front render (hidden behind the bezel), so it has no mesh. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 23.0 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 875 = 23.83 mm -> 23.75, lug bottom y 2009 = 25.48 mm -> 25.5, crown guards to x 1499 = 23.4 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: black ceramic insert (bezel_in 15.97 .. insert_out 20.02 mm), polished rim to rim_out 20.30, coin edge (60 flutes, silhouette ripple about 1 px peak to peak) from there to the tips at 21.5 mm sloping down to z_coin_out; ridge at 3.3 deg mod 6 deg

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the lume, Mercedes lines and black facets stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (the thick guards are in the case slab): flutes x 1452..1522, cap to 1544, axis 0.57 mm below the pivot, radius 3.48 mm

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet (Glidelock end): brushed outer links and a wider centre link. Joint rows (px, 23.0 px/mm, pivot (960, 1423)): outer top 736.5, end 652; outer bottom 2206 / 2386 / 2502, end 2548; centre top 842 / 703, end 649; centre bottom 2059.5 / 2264 / 2428.5 / 2517.5, end 2548; column lines x 854.8 / 1064.3 (top), 853.8 / 1064.8 (bottom). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

date.note: Cyclops lens: photographed outline (measure.date.lens_px, 7.3 x 5.7 mm, centre 9.3 mm right of the pivot) as a wall + two bevel rings + flat top above the crystal; photo projection, emission = dial; heights are scaled by pose.depth_scale like every part
